description.value: Browns Socialhouse Lower Lonsdale is a casual chain social-house restaurant in the heart of the Lower Lonsdale neighbourhood, just a short walk from the SeaBus terminal connecting North Vancouver to downtown Vancouver. The venue offers both indoor and outdoor seating and serves brunch on weekends and holidays, making it a versatile stop for cyclists arriving or departing via the SeaBus. It is part of the Browns Restaurant Group, with dozens of BC locations.
